'''Slobberlama''' is a [[Grass]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Lollama]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Ptooielama]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Slobberlama tries hard to contribute to the Tatari community. When serving fruit, for example, each piece is carefully licked to make sure they're sweet enough."

Slobberlama is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

== Evolution Trial ==
Slobberlama's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Ptooielama]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Slobberlama to increase stats 3 times.
* Shoot 20,000 pinballs.
